_comment: Fixture for L24. Two credible sources report the SAME metric with DIFFERENT values and DIFFERENT publication dates (a conflict synthesis must preserve, not resolve). facet_findings supplies per-facet claims the mock subagents 'return'. The two conflicting observations also appear inside facet_findings (visual arts + music) so run_research surfaces the conflict end-to-end.
